entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: A sixteen-year-old guildless girl from Ravnica with a Curse of Insignificance who guides Teyo during the War of the Spark and is secretly the Dimir assassin Atkos Tarr.

entities.name: Atkos Tarr
entities.description: A second persona sculpted by Lazav for Rat, a male vampire Dimir assassin triggered by a palindromic name.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: The Dimir guildmaster who recruited and brainwashed Rat into becoming his secret assassin.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The secretive Ravnican guild that recruited Rat as an assassin.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: Rat's best friend and Rakdos emissary, who dies and is resurrected as a blood witch and leads the Rakdos against Bolas.

entities.name: Ari Shokta
entities.description: Rat's Gruul mother.

entities.name: Boruvo
entities.description: Rat's centaur godfather.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A young planeswalker whom Rat guides on his first arrival at Ravnica and on whom she develops a crush.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who rallies Ravnica's guilds against Bolas and travels with Rat and Teyo.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Kaya, Teyo and Rat search for and later help on her path to redemption.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker whose invasion of Ravnica the guilds fight.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The invasion of Ravnica by Bolas and his Dreadhorde.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The guild ruled by a triumvirate that Kaya persuades to join the fight.

entities.name: Armin Morov
entities.description: The human pontiff in the Orzhov triumvirate.

entities.name: Slavomir Zoltan
entities.description: The vampire tithe-master in the Orzhov triumvirate.

entities.name: Maladola
entities.description: The angel warrior-executioner in the Orzhov triumvirate.

entities.name: Bilagru
entities.description: The Orzhov Syndicate's giant chief enforcer who convinces the triumvirate to join the fight.

entities.name: Tomik Vrona
entities.description: An Orzhov representative who persuaded Bilagru and brought Hekara's corpse to Rix Maadi.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild led by Emmara Tandris and Trostani that agrees to help the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: The acting guildmaster of the Selesnya Conclave, who initially refused to help.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The Selesnya entity who awakens and rules in favor of helping the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The Ravnican guild led by Borborygmos.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: The cyclops leader of the Gruul Clans with a soft spot for Rat.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who accompanies the group to the Undercity and Rix Maadi.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: The gorgon leader of the Golgari Swarm who unites it and pledges it to the fight against Bolas.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose leaders squabble over Vraska's throne.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The demon lord of the Cult of Rakdos, initially hostile after Hekara's death.

entities.name: Exava
entities.description: A blood witch who orders the group to leave Rix Maadi and is defeated by Hekara.

entities.name: Rix Maadi
entities.description: The Rakdos guildhall where the group negotiates.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: The Golgari domain where Vraska is found and civilians are evacuated.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads a team that helps evacuate civilians to the tunnels.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A Ravnican figure assassinated by Atkos Tarr in his safe house.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who recommends splitting into teams.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The spirit dragon with whom Rat briefly speaks via the Spirit-Gem.

entities.name: Zahid
entities.description: A djinn defeated on Dominaria.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Rat's home plane.

entities.name: Spirit-Gem
entities.description: An artifact through which Rat briefly speaks with Ugin.

events.summary: Rat guides Teyo, newly arrived on Ravnica, sharing what she overheard about planeswalking.
events.quote: Rat acted as Teyo Verada 's guide to the city plane when the young planeswalker first arrived.

events.summary: Rat, Teyo and Kaya meet the Orzhov triumvirate, and Bilagru convinces them to join the fight against Bolas.
events.quote: the triumvirate agreed to have the Orzhov Syndicate join the fight

events.summary: Selesnya agrees to help after Trostani awakens and overrules Emmara Tandris.
events.quote: her decision was overruled when Trostani awakened and ruled in favor of helping the Gatewatch

events.summary: Rat convinces Borborygmos to support the cause.
events.quote: Rat convinced the cyclops (who had a soft spot for her) to support their cause.

events.summary: Vraska returns and unites the Golgari, pledging them to the fight, and civilians are evacuated to the tunnels.
events.quote: Vraska pledged the Golgari to the fight against Bolas.

events.summary: At Rix Maadi, Tomik brings Hekara's corpse, the cultists resurrect her as a blood witch, and she defeats Exava and leads the Rakdos against Bolas.
events.quote: the Rakdos cultists resurrected Hekara as a blood witch

events.summary: Heartbroken that Teyo and Kaya will leave, Rat departs without goodbye, but Teyo finds her and she joins them.
events.quote: Rat was heart-broken and left their company before saying goodbye

events.summary: On Dominaria, Rat helps find Liliana, defeat an imposter, and persuade Kaya to let Liliana live.
events.quote: Rat helped convince Kaya to let Liliana live

events.summary: Lazav recruits Rat into the Dimir and brainwashes her into a secret assassin.
events.quote: Lazav periodically approached Rat in various forms as he slowly brainwashed the young girl

events.summary: Lazav sculpts the persona Atkos Tarr for Rat, who assassinates Dovin Baan.
events.quote: Lazav had Atkos Tarr assassinate Dovin Baan in his secret safe house on Ravnica .

relations.note: A second personality sculpted by Lazav.
relations.quote: she also has a second personality as the House Dimir assassin Atkos Tarr

relations.note: Secretly recruited and brainwashed into his assassin.
relations.quote: had secretly been recruited into the Dimir years earlier

relations.note: She developed a crush on him.
relations.quote: She also developed a crush on Teyo.
Rat traveled with Kaya and Teyo on their quest to find Liliana Vess
Lazav had Atkos Tarr assassinate Dovin Baan

relations.note: As a blood witch she leads the Rakdos against Bolas.
relations.quote: Hekara used her newfound authority as a blood witch to lead the Rakdos against Bolas.
